events.body:
## Context

BLT-Timer-Flutter (`blt-timer-flutter/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-timer-flutter): it meets 90% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Bronze (the basics: a README, a description, a licence and a logo)

- **Project logo.** Add `logo.svg` (and `logo.png`) to the folder, following the logo guide on design.owaspblt.org.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Project logo
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-timer-flutter` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-timer-flutter
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-timer-flutter
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
